question:
Which of the following parts of a plant cell has a function that is most similar to the function of an animal skeleton?
A. cell membrane
B. cell wall
C. chloroplast
D. nucleus
answer:
B. 

The cell wall, which is found in plant cells, serves as structural support and protection for the cell, much like how an animal's skeleton provides a framework for their body and protects internal organs. This allows plants to maintain their shape and withstand external forces such as wind or gravity.

question:
Which of the following parts of a plant cell has a function that is most similar to the function of an animal skeleton?
A. cell membrane
B. cell wall
C. chloroplast
D. nucleus
answer:
B. Cell walls in plants provide structural support and protection, much like the function of an animal skeleton.

The cell wall is a rigid structure outside the cell membrane that gives shape to the plant cell and provides mechanical support against external forces. In contrast, an animal skeleton (such as bone or cartilage) also serves to provide structural support and protection for the body.

question:
Janette conducts an investigation to see which foods make her feel more fatigued. She eats one of four different foods each day at the same time for four days and then records how she feels. She asks her friend Carmen to do the same investigation to see if she gets similar results. Which would make the investigation most difficult to replicate?
A. measuring the amount of fatigue
B. making sure the same foods are eaten
C. recording observations in the same chart
D. making sure the foods are at the same temperature
answer:
B. making sure the same foods are eaten

This is because Janette and Carmen may have different preferences or allergies, which could affect their results. If they both eat different foods, it would be difficult to compare their data and determine whether the food itself or something else caused the fatigue. This variable (the type of food) needs to be controlled in order for the investigation to be replicable.
